description: This file generates help and documentation for a CLI tool related to Playwright, including functions to produce command help text, readme content, and JSON help data, with categorization of commands.

methods.name: commandArgs
methods.description: Extracts command arguments with their descriptions and optionality from a command schema.

methods.name: commandArgsText
methods.description: Formats command arguments into a string for display.

methods.name: generateCommandHelp
methods.description: Creates detailed help text for a specific command.

methods.name: generateHelp
methods.description: Generates the overall help text for the CLI, organized by command categories.

methods.name: generateReadme
methods.description: Creates a markdown-formatted readme content listing commands by category.

methods.name: generateHelpEntry
methods.description: Formats a single command's help entry for CLI output.

methods.name: generateReadmeEntry
methods.description: Formats a command's entry for the readme in markdown.

methods.name: unwrapZodType
methods.description: Recursively unwraps nested Zod schemas to get the core schema.

methods.name: generateHelpJSON
methods.description: Produces a JSON object containing help information, including global help, command-specific help, and boolean options.

methods.name: formatWithGap
methods.description: Formats text with a gap for alignment in CLI output.
